problems.title: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
problems.notes: classic two-pointer intro; contrast with the hash-map Two Sum I on an unsorted array

problems.title: Move Zeroes
problems.notes: slow write-pointer / fast read-pointer in-place partition, single pass, no extra array

problems.title: Valid Palindrome
problems.notes: pointer-in-pointer-out with alnum skipping; watch case folding and unicode edge cases

problems.title: 3Sum
problems.notes: sort + fix one index + two pointers; the dedup logic (skip equal neighbors) is the actual interview bar

problems.title: Container With Most Water
problems.notes: greedy two-pointer proof: always move the shorter wall, never the taller one — be ready to prove why

problems.title: 3Sum Closest
problems.notes: same sweep as 3Sum but track the running best diff instead of collecting exact-zero triples

problems.title: 4Sum
problems.notes: generalizes 3Sum with an extra fixed index; a good prompt to discuss general k-sum recursion

problems.title: Sort Colors
problems.notes: Dutch National Flag three-pointer partition, one pass, O(1) space — the canonical follow-up to quicksort partition

problems.title: Trapping Rain Water
problems.notes: two-pointer O(1)-space solution beats the prefix-max-array O(n)-space solution; know both and the tradeoff
